_doc: PROMOTE-1 fact bank. The only source of claims and numbers in application kits. Each fact has a probe that foundation/promote.py evaluates on every --check and --kits run; a fact whose probe fails cannot be rendered, so a kit never states something the repository does not prove. Probe kinds: file:PATH, grep:PATH::REGEX, nogrep:PATH::REGEX, jsonlen:PATH::KEY (with op and value), http:URL (live mode only). Edit by PR.
